labels.caption: Stress-intensity curves of the 12 policies of part second on weeks 301--304 (4 weeks, policy seed 0): cost over all-fallback against the reclaim probability $p$ of the i.i.d. lender per site and slot, on the grid $p\in\{0, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2, 0.34, 0.5, 0.8, 1\}$ ($p=0$ is the honoring lender L-hon; part main's runs and part second's merged). Medians over the 4 weeks with their ranges; the weeks are rotations of one series. Sublet is drawn and labeled in every panel; the grey line marks all-fallback. The $p$ axis has a square-root scale (minor ticks: the grid's other points), and the series of a panel are offset horizontally by 1.4 pt each, so that equal medians stay apart. Critical-ratio renting's medians lie within 0.0001 of Sublet's at every $p$. At $p=0$, Greedy + guard; Greedy renting; and Greedy, back-off share the median 0.632. At $p\ge0.5$, Lagged RetroRenting + one-way guard ($B_0=10\%$ of the all-fallback bill) and RetroRenting-style differ by at most 0.03. Each policy's first $p$ with a cost above 1, on every week, is in Table~\ref{tab:e7v2-crossings}.
